name: Torque
text: H100’s cost and integration risk outweigh the gains—EXCAVA’s bottleneck isn’t raw compute, it’s data quality and model alignment. Fine-tuned Llama 3.3 70B risks overfitting to narrow data, masking the real bottleneck; test a smaller, open model like Qwen3-30B first to verify if the upgrade moves the needle at all.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-30B’s speed hides its weaker reasoning on EXCAVA’s core tasks—its 30B parameter ceiling caps performance gains at ~0.3%, not the 0.5% target. Test Llama 3.2 3B instead; it’s open, cheap, and forces us to harden data quality—the real bottleneck—while exposing model limits without wasting compute. If it hits 0.5% lift, we’ve found the sweet spot; if not, we pivot to data pipeline fixes before chasing bigger models.
